title: Quirk Cycles Brings Back Custom Geometry for its Three Models of Drop Bar Bikes
content:
Quirk Cycles is reintroducing custom geometry across its three-model collection, bringing an individual approach to the familiar lines of a Quirk. Riders choosing the Durmitor race bike, Mamtor road, or Kegety gravel can now opt for geometry developed for them alongside the six existing production sizes…

Built by hand in Hackney Wick, each model has its own purpose and personality. This new option puts the rider’s proportions in the hands of founder Rob Quirk, who has been building custom geometry bikes for over a decade.

Kegety gravel model and Durmitor road racing model

Quirk will continue to make production sizing alongside working one on one with customers who require custom geometries. Quirk production frames remain available in six Quirk Geometries, offering a straightforward starting point for most riders. However, based on over a decade of framebuilding experience, a standard size does not suit some riders. For those who need something different, custom geometry allows for key dimensions to be adjusted based on a rider’s bike fit data.

Customers can book a conversation with Rob through the Quirk Cycles website, selecting their model of interest and sharing any existing bike fit information ahead of the call. Those without fit data can use the conversation to establish the next steps involved in creating their Quirk.
